gen-gf-warnes-gf-julius-sans-one: Stretched out and splashy, with ink that fades before it lands. Julius Sans One matches that spaciousness with wide gaps and open curves, so Warnes feels like it has company.
gen-tourney-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads wide and smooth, its curves staying distinct beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height. And Tourney is the loud one, cut in uniform strokes with bulky lowercase, while the body simply lets the words flow.
gen-gf-oxanium-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab keeps the middle of each line dense and tidy, with open throats on its a, c, e and s. Reading it feels steady.
gen-flavors-mulish: Chunky, playful and towering. Mulish keeps every stroke at the same weight with horseshoe-open apertures, and that gentle uniformity is what lets Flavors show off without a fight.
gen-gf-gugi-rubik: Rubik has soft, large lowercase and round shapes that stay legible when small. Gugi brings tall, bold lowercase with open terminals for the loud moments, while Rubik handles the quiet ones.
gen-gf-paprika-roboto-slab: Paprika scatters its letters far apart, and its lowercase fills the line almost like capitals. Roboto Slab feels tidier beside it, structured where the heading is loose.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-rubik: Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders that barely clear the x-height and terminals that flick outward, all in one level beat. Rubik follows with soft, large lowercase that would read smoothly down a whole page.
gen-gf-revalia-bitter: Wide-striding and loose, with an open-bottomed g and a tall band of letters. Bitter grounds it with a large lowercase eye and see-through s shapes, which is what makes Revalia feel safe to lean on.
gen-gf-metamorphous-rubik: Rubik brings a big, soft lowercase and round letters that stay readable when small. Metamorphous has generous sidebearings, a high midline and curves whose thin points still carry weight, which gives the pair its commanding quality.
gen-gf-revalia-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab packs the middle of each line densely, with open throats on its a, c, e and s. Revalia's wide-striding g and spaced letters loosen the top, and the slab tightens the rest.
